summary: Full stack testing of TradeAlert Bot. All 12 backend API tests pass. All frontend pages load and work correctly. Core issue: Telegram alerts failing with 'Bad Request: chat not found' due to incorrect CHAT_ID configuration.

critical.issue: Telegram API returns 'Bad Request: chat not found' for CHAT_ID 1003383502. Bot has not been started/used by that user. All alerts fail - alert_sent=false for all trades.

ui_bugs.issue: Stats cards (TOTAL, SENT, FAILED) show 0 even when alerts exist in the list. The counts compute correctly from the data but there may be a race condition where stats=0 state shows before data loads. On page load, TOTAL shows 0 but 2 alert items are displayed.

issues: Dashboard looks good - dark theme, proper contrast, all sections visible

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Telegram CHAT_ID - 'Bad Request: chat not found'. The bot token 8588455217 is valid but CHAT_ID 1003383502 is not reachable. User needs to start a conversation with the bot first (send /start), or get the correct chat_id from https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates
MEDIUM: Alert Logs stats cards (TOTAL/SENT/FAILED) display 0 on initial page load despite alerts being present - investigate the stats fetch timing/initialization
critical_code_review_comments: notification_service.py uses sync requests in _send_sync() and runs it in asyncio.to_thread - acceptable but adds latency for each retry attempt (up to 3x10s timeout = 30s per request)
Rate limiting implemented with global _last_sent_time which is process-level, not persistent across restarts - fine for current use case
Alert log stats in AlertLogs.jsx computed client-side with a separate full fetch (limit=1000) rather than using a dedicated stats endpoint - could be optimized

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all pages load, all interactions work, Telegram delivery fails due to config issue)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test trades (ETHUSDT via pytest, BTCUSDT via UI) and associated alert logs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 100% passing. Frontend all pages working. Main issue is Telegram CHAT_ID misconfiguration. Test trades exist in DB. Alert logs show failed status. Analytics page shows charts (symbol/regime distribution working). PnL chart shows 'No closed trades yet' (expected - no exit trades submitted).
rca_of_issue: Telegram 'Bad Request: chat not found' - The bot has never been used by chat ID 1003383502. For a bot to send messages to a user via chat_id, that user must first initiate a conversation with the bot by sending /start. The fix: user should message the bot at t.me/<bot_username>, or if this is a group/channel, add the bot as admin. Then re-fetch the correct chat_id via https://api.telegram.org/bot8588455217:AAE7beZ-5rfz4ypWpy_HHc9w3yacKgaUs_A/getUpdates
